newsitem.title: USA: Performance results overstated, sees loss.
newsitem.headline: Performance results overstated, sees loss.

text.p: Performance Nutrition Inc said Thursday that revenues and earnings for fiscal 1995 and the nine-month period ending June 30 1996 appear to have been significantly overstated.

The company said preliminary results from an investigation by Ernst & Young LLP show that for fiscal 1995 it had a net loss of about $232,000 on revenues of $3.396 million, and for the 1996 nine-month period it had a net loss of about $908,000 on revenues of $2.296 million.

Net losses for 1995 and the nine-month period in 1996 might rise if adjustments are needed to bring financial statements into compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles, the company said.
